mentions.name: Tritium
mentions.description: A legal IDE written in Rust built around a word processor for legal documents. This month's work includes CI/CD for e2e testing across Windows, macOS, Linux and Android, support for unlocking password-protected PDFs and Word docs, background OCR that leverages native OS OCR where available and a pure LSTM Rust implementation elsewhere, a cross-platform spellchecker using native engines where possible, and general word processor speedups. It can be tried online in a preview and downloaded for free.
